テキスト cha 464: Born Shiyo 779, May 18. Height 169cm (as of Shiyo 800). Haruka Niimura's older cousin. Graceful, with un-Japanese looks and air and blue-and-green odd eyes. Yet a violent drunk, she blunders at every college drinking party; even men kind at first leave within hours: no love life, plenty of heartbreak. Natsumi Kogori calls her 'a beauty with a catch.' On the rebound, she took to Erina Goto at first sight and clung to her all the way to the Arata settlement.
Back at her family home, she seems to be letting her hair down and enjoying her drink to the fullest. Her drinking habits, which tend to put people off in Tokyo, are taken in stride by her family.

According to her younger sister, Kana Niimura, Chigaya Niimura is quite a big eater. Even after seeing how Erina Goto eats, Kana insists her older sister is still better. But Chigaya Niimura herself is not especially interested in big eating; she is usually satisfied with an ordinary single portion, and it seems she simply can eat any amount when she sets her mind to it. If she feels like it, five plates of curry take her less than 10 minutes.

When Erina Goto points out her old-looking face and the swell of her chest, she flies into open fury, helped along by the drink. Joining hands with Natsumi Kogori, whom she recognizes as a comrade, she sets out to defeat Erina Goto in an Arata-style contest.
Together with her sister Kana Niimura, she claims they were made to train to kill. Why she thinks so is unknown at this stage.

She believes Kotaro Niimura is the culprit behind the curse-killings, and as the group starts to grow wary of him, she urges them to escape the Arata settlement at once. But at Arata Station they run into Kotaro Niimura and the others, and she is cut in two by a resident who used the drug called Droga, and dies.

Since the Motoki-cho group is to head to the Arata settlement on foot with Kana Niimura, she travels with Mifuyu Niimura, just the two of them. In their conversation, putting off the plan to switch places at the succession rite is discussed. There is also a description that reads as though she had heard something from Mifuyu Niimura about Natsumi Kogori and Erina Goto.

When Erina Goto presses her, saying "the culprit of the curse-killings can only be you," she holds a knife to Erina. According to Erina, having lost Sakura Niimura, she feared losing even Kotaro Niimura, who was suspected as the culprit, and so killed one of those who suspected him each year. Her confession suggests the knife was the murder weapon. But her one remark that she herself had wanted to kill her mother changes Erina's thinking completely.
She was to study abroad from the summer of Shiyo 800, but it seems she means to quit university and return to the Arata settlement, because she cannot leave Kana Niimura alone.

Back from studying abroad, she happens to be asked to enter an eating contest while in Tokyo, and enters out of curiosity. She loses the final to Erina Goto by a hair, but afterward befriends her and goes to the US with her to master the way of competitive eating. Years later, she saves starving people around the world through food, but she seems to have made some mistake in the past, and like Erina, she keeps up her charity work to atone.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 464: The Megasawa City case was set off by efforts to treat the urge to kill she had as a member of the third generation. On the route where the Megasawa City case happened, both her eyes are blue; on the route where it did not, she has odd eyes, one blue and one green. In other words, on the route where the Megasawa City case did not happen, she still had danger sense.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 464: Under the 'Blessing' given off by the Verde mummy, her constitution changes to that of the fourth generation, and she becomes obsessed with the Verde mummy. In time she loses her human functions and becomes a new cherry embryo.

On April 3, Shiyo 790, she develops the Green-Eye Curse-Killing under the influence of Sakura Niimura's precognition. Locked in the underground storeroom for several days, she falls into frenzies and fainting fits over and over and comes close to death. Either way, the Green-Eye Curse-Killing is cured by giving her falsificaso, or by Sakura Niimura throwing away her precognition.

In the Sakura Niimura beheading case, she witnessed the moment of the beheading. Her grandmother Erika Niimura tried to save Sakura but was not strong enough and let her fall; right after, her father Kotaro Niimura cut off Sakura's head. Erika knew this but kept it hidden for 10 years. Afraid that telling would cost her even her father and grandmother, Chigaya also kept the truth of the beheading case to herself.

Her wild drinking is alive and well in Tokyo: she goes to drinking parties for the men, soon stops caring, and just drinks the night away. So there is no sign of a boyfriend, and though she regrets it each time, she repeats it once she drinks. Asking Mifuyu Niimura's advice, she is told "forcing yourself to change will only wear you out," but also gently told she had better do something about her drinking.

Chigaya Niimura lost her mother as a small child and saw her father cut off the head. Dreading the loss of her family, from Shiyo 791 to 795 she killed, one by one, those who suspected her father: so it was none other than Chigaya Niimura who started the curse-killings. Green-eyed, she is also of the third generation, able to foresee danger in cherry season. Whether she confesses her curse-killings to Mifuyu Niimura seems to be a major branch point.

She confesses to Mifuyu Niimura the curse-killings she has committed. Mifuyu takes it head-on, and at last she is ready to open her heart. But right after, she learns of Natsumi Kogori's precognition and shudders. She also begins to sense that someone may be lurking behind it all.

She learns from Mifuyu Niimura that Kotaro Niimura had no known grounds for insisting "Erika Niimura pushed Sakura Niimura off," and that every curse-killed body had its head smashed with a blunt instrument. Having believed she stabbed them with a knife, she finally sees too much is puzzling for her to be the curse-killer. To solve it fast, she asks Mifuyu Niimura to let her meet Erina Goto at once.

What Chigaya Niimura does not know about the curse-killings is 'why' they happened. To find that out quickly, Erina Goto tells her to gather every piece of information before the thirteenth-year memorial service. Following this, she heads for the Arata settlement earlier than planned.

Going by the memo and smartphone that Haruka Niimura and Erina Goto find, she seems to have already reached an ending that looks like the truth. But she was apparently kidnapped by people who seem to be Sakura Niimura and Eiichiro Niimura.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～焦点～
テキスト cha 464: Erina Goto and the others find her collapsed in the underground storeroom. She looks exhausted, and her odd eyes have been cured. After finding the Verde mummy deep in the storeroom and offering a prayer, she apparently decides they must head for the summit at once, and goes with Erina.

Arriving at the Arata settlement, she wastes no time looking through the storehouse's books. From a report by the Holy Cerejeira Church, she learns that what she took for the Arata cherry is a fungus, and that Droga is nothing but a tool to help it reproduce.

Absorbed in hunting for clues to the curse-killings, she is suddenly struck by something baffling: at least one of Kotaro Niimura and Erika Niimura must know what the books say. Her grounds are the door newly fitted under the storehouse, and she realizes that no matter how she searches the books there, she will never find it. So at least one of the two is covering it up to keep the truth from her.

To find the books she believes are hidden, she searches the Niimura main house. Along the way she finds Kana Niimura's exchange diary and burns with jealousy, but learning it is all her sister's fantasy, she gently advises her how to solve her troubles. She offers no apology or comment for barging into someone's privacy; she must have felt a pleasant sense of conquest. What a nasty personality...

By reading the hidden books, she lets Shigatsu Youka learn of her investigation. She is kidnapped by Sakura Niimura and Eiichiro Niimura, who have been put to work, but by some chance she apparently manages to stop them in their tracks.

Having barely escaped with her life from Sakura Niimura and the other, she has fled into the abandoned hut. Now, so that Shigatsu Youka cannot work out where she is, she shuts off her own sight and hearing.

To get everyone away from Shigatsu Youka, she starts by deceiving the people around her. Her plan: pretend to side with Shigatsu Youka, confine the Motoki-cho group in the abandoned hut, then let them all escape at once when she sees an opening. She also means to push the residents to evacuate the settlement by letting them hear eerie proposals.

On the way to the settlement she encounters Sakura Niimura. Urged to run, she suspects a trap of Shigatsu Youka's, keeps up her feigned madness as planned, and insists on joining Shigatsu Youka. It was indeed a trap, it seems; the work is split, Sakura and the other clearing the landslide and Chigaya persuading the residents, and she manages to act alone.

She meets Haruka Niimura and the rest of the Motoki-cho group and succeeds in steering them to the abandoned hut without revealing her true intentions. But Shigatsu Youka apparently saw through them, and an attack by Eiichiro Niimura leaves her unable to move.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～虚虚実実～
テキスト cha 464: Having changed into the fourth generation, she has lost her former human self. She has sunk to being Shigatsu Youka's servant completely, and with Eiichiro Niimura she tries to take Erina Goto to Shigatsu Youka as a hostage.

To get rid of the Verde mummy, she had been pretending to be infected with Droga. Her frenzy until now was all an act, which is why she treated Erina Goto so harshly. And since the living first generation (the fourth generation included) has no precognition, Shigatsu Youka could not see through her act.
死月妖花との対峙、十三回忌、さらに2日前からのサバイバル生活で疲弊していたが、まだやるべきことがあると気づき、五島絵梨奈とともに地下倉庫へ向かう。

新村幸太郎から呪殺事件の真相を隠し続けていたことを聞き、一時はその罪を責めるが、五島絵梨奈に「それはたまたま新村幸太郎がターゲットにされただけ」と言われる。また彼女自身も呪殺事件の犯人であると思い込んでいたのは、例の直感を通じて新村サクラから殺人を唆されたためであり、結局は自分も新村幸太郎とは何も変わりがないことに気づく。これ以上悲しいこと、凄惨なことが起こらないよう、何があっても新村幸太郎の味方であり続けることを誓い、新村サクラへの未練から巣立つ決心をする。
